attack_parameters.attack_type: Small position jump with initial and continuous jamming
attack_parameters.simulated_position: North end of the football field - 69.27701401, 15.969328354, 45 m HAE
attack_parameters.description: For sub-scenario 2.3.2, we simulate a small position jump with 5 minutes of initial jamming on L1, G1, B1I, E6, L2, E5b, L5 (2 W) before spoofing begins, then continuous jamming on other bands. The spoofing signals themselves are GPS L1 C/A, L2C, L5 and Galileo E1, E5, all at 0.316 W power.
